_meta.pvp_caveat: AOS addon guidance from sources/discord-pvp.md (currency uncertain). AOS (capped) scope only.

skill_choices.general: Take all Prime skills — the stronger Succession variants.

locked.reason: Mostly useless; it is the only Bound in the kit — unlock only if a fight needs Bound (e.g. Pig King).
Unnecessary (video); locked in Discord list too.

locked.name: Rage Transfer
locked.reason: Common BSR skill on X — can input-conflict with Shift+X (Heavenly Return / Spirit Parade) and would transfer 50% of your Black Spirit's Rage to another player. Identified by user in grill (2026-06-11); BDO Codex skill id 91.

do_not_learn.reason: Magnus skill: useless in PvE (inconsistent line multihit; 1–2 hits are bad). Leaving it unlearned keeps Soulflame (E) usable. PvP combos that use it require learning it — trade-off to settle in grill.

aos_unlock.reason: Locked for grinding, but the rank 1 AOS Maegu opens with it — a Super-Armor-protected long-range AoE poke. Its Bound is PvE-only, so the PvE lock reasoning doesn't carry to AOS (sources/rank1-aos-observation.md, 2026-06-12).

quickslot.reason: Can only be used from quickslot (slot 0 in author's setup).

skill_choices.quickslot_note: Keep combat skills OFF the quickslot bar: casting from a slot plays the skill from neutral, losing the chained/cancelled versions the kit is built on — the sheet measures Spirit Sparks at 27,815 DPS from slot vs 39,367 via its Constricting Charm flow. Quickslot only what has no keyboard input.

choices.rationale: Heavenly Return: fast, decent damage, quick backstep; unprotected but fast enough that it rarely matters in PvE. Spirit Parade: less damage, longer animation, but Super Armor — the protected option, and the PvP pick (all Bantalope combos use it).

choices.aos_pick_note: AOS pick set from observed rank-1 gameplay (sources/rank1-aos-observation.md, 2026-06-12), matching BDFoundry — not from the original locked sources.
choices.rationale: Constricting Charm: decent filler with very high attack speed; flows into Spirit Sparks (the grinding pick). Petal Snare: low PvE DPS, but the rank 1 AOS Maegu plays it — a ranged CC poke fits the AOS pattern.

choices.aos_pick_note: AOS pick read directly off the rank-1 player's skill enhancement tree screenshot (sources/rank1-images/skill-enhancements.png, 2026-06-12).
choices.rationale: Spirit Sparks: weak alone but decent follow-up from Constricting Charm (the grinding pick — useless in AOS where 57 = Petal Snare kills its flow). Soul Charm: not useful in PvE, but a quickslot self-heal has real value in AOS where consumables are limited — and it is what rank 1 runs.

rabams.tree: Each level branches from one of two parent skills: Lv56 Soulflame III → Heavenly Return / Soulsnare III → Spirit Parade; Lv57 Petalblast III → Petal Snare / Spirit Swirl IV → Constricting Charm; Lv58 Bristling Sparks IV → Spirit Sparks / Spirited Away IV → Soul Charm.

notes: Several options are flexible; Nukduri Dance could be swapped (author keeps Special Attack on it from habit of using it early as the AP buff).
Movement speed can be swapped at tower spots (e.g. HP on hit).
Down attack matters at spots like Star's End — can replace back attack or DR where movement speed stays valuable.
Midgame (more -DP wanted): Spirited Away → Foxflare with -DR/Attack Speed; Bristling Sparks +DR → Crit Dmg; Nukduri Dance → Petal Play with -DR/Crit Dmg.

aos.caveat: Currency uncertain. Read image for exact per-skill values (Evasion build vs DR build columns).
notes: Addons are subjective/playstyle-dependent; these cover as many combos as possible.
DR build: addons on Spirited Away fill combos from Foxflare that skip Bared Claws.
Evasion build: HP regen on Nukduri Dance is a big chunk (it already regens and hits 10 targets); eva setups rotating SA exploit it better than DR setups.
Capped modes: self buffs/debuffs count against caps — upkeeping DR/evasion/accuracy and applying DP debuffs matters more than before.

Observed evasion-build #1 addon loadout (2026-06-13, sources/rank1-aos-observation.md): Bared Claws +30% Crit Rate/+5% Crit Dmg (self, on his most-woven cancel = cheap uptime); Foxflare -20 DR/-20 Evasion to target; Spirit Swirl +20 DR/+20 Evasion (self); Flower Shroud +10% Attack Speed/-20 DR to target; Spirited Away +20 Accuracy/+5% Down Atk; Heavenward Dance -20 Accuracy to target/+5% Back Atk. Built around the accuracy/evasion war. (Earlier DR-build #1 ran raw-crit addons with the -DR/-Eva debuff on Bared Claws instead.)
Standalone DR / Evasion / Capped profiles exist but are intentionally out of scope (user plays AOS only).

rules: AP — take unless >10 over AP cap.
Crit Rate — take; extremely high BSR uptime.
Down Dmg — only for down-attack spots like Star's End.
Crit Dmg — always good but lower value.
Back Dmg — usually good for tanky mobs.
DR — comfort if needed, or free slot; if you can't drop AP/Crit Rate for it, swap Crit Dmg.

buffs.note: These do not stack with each other. Nukduri Dance is strongest but long CD; Charmed is the backup; Nether River rarely, buffs with frontal guard.
3-min CD; overwrites the +20 AP buffs → effectively +5 over them. Weak vs other classes' 3-min buffs.

debuffs.note: The only one you have; stacks with addon -DR. Apply at the start of fights.

notes: 100% BSR Heavenward Dance is lower DPS than normal Heavenward Dance but larger AoE.
Z absorb typically preferred — absorb animation is fast.
Sheet attack speed assumptions: 37% before BSR, 62% in BSR.
Rage Transfer (common skill, X) is locked — it would send 50% of your rage to another player on a Shift+X misfire.
Study guide should include a short BSR explainer (user is unfamiliar with the BSR abilities): Z = absorb rage for the buff, W+RMB at 100% = BSR Heavenward Dance, X = Rage Transfer (locked).

earlygame.summary: Move and aim to hit many monsters; use ranged skills between packs.

ui_reference.scheme: Movement/utility in the top 8 hotbar slots; DPS abilities in DPS-priority order in the bottom 12 (left→right, top→bottom). Quickslot: Foxspirit Form slot 0, MouseFunction slot 5.
